text: Given a Recorder stub for Persons/dx returning 3 rows for tenantId=119, When immybot_persons_list(tenantId=119, limit=2) is called, Then the result contains exactly 2 persons and has_more is true.
evidence: Round 1 fix (see PRD-21590-review.md): the original stub ignored take and always returned 3 rows, so has_more came out True via listing()'s len(items)>limit default even though that default can never be True against the real vendor (take=<limit> caps the response). persons.py now derives has_more from the vendor's totalCount (total > limit), falling back to len(raw_rows) >= limit like maintenance_sessions.py:110. uv run pytest -k persons -v on TESTED=fcc49e8 (synced with main@445a57a): test_persons_list_caps_at_limit_and_sets_has_more PASSED with a take-honoring stub (returns rows[:take], totalCount=3) -- take=2 request gets back exactly 2 rows, has_more True because total(3) > limit(2); new test_persons_list_no_more_when_total_within_limit PASSED -- take=2 request where totalCount==2 (all rows returned) asserts has_more False, proving the fix does not just flip to always-True.

text: Given a Recorder stub for Persons/dx that returns one row for tenantId=119 and one row for a different tenantId, When immybot_persons_list(tenantId=119) is called, Then only the matching tenant's row is present in the result.
evidence: uv run pytest -k persons -v on TESTED=959ac83: test_persons_list_filters_out_other_tenants_defensively PASSED. Stub returned one row for tenantId=119 and one for tenantId=5; called with tenantId=119; only id=1 (tenantId=119) came back. Mirrors the defensive tenantId re-filter already used by immybot_computers_list (computers.py:75).

text: Given the server built via create_mcp_server(), When tools/list is read, Then immybot_persons_list is present with required parameter {tenantId}, the total tool count is 69, and immybot_navigate(domain="persons") lists immybot_persons_list.
evidence: Round 1: uv run pytest -q on TESTED=959ac83: 528 passed. Round 1 fix: dev/PRD-21590 was re-synced with main (now at 445a57a, which had meanwhile merged PRD-21588's immybot_computers_set_primary_user) before re-running gates for the has_more fix; the merge auto-resolved test_tools.py and README.md textually but silently left both sides' tool-count bumps colliding at a stale 72 against an actual registered count of 73 -- caught by uv run pytest -q on TESTED=fcc49e8 (synced with main@445a57a): 537 passed, 11 skipped, 0 failed, including test_tool_names_are_stable (now asserting 73), test_required_params[immybot_persons_list], and test_navigate_lists_every_tool. README's "Tool count" line corrected 72 -> 73 in the same fix. This does not weaken AC6: the check is still that the new tool is present, reachable via the "persons" domain, and the total matches the actual registered set -- confirmed live via a local tools/list call on TESTED=fcc49e8 (port 19590) returning exactly 73 tools including immybot_persons_list with required {tenantId}, and a 401 when the four X-Immybot-* headers are omitted.
